relatedSourceLedgerEntries.title: WHO Pandemic Agreement remains adopted but not fully open for ratification until PABS annex is negotiated
relatedSourceLedgerEntries.summary: WHO states the Pandemic Agreement was adopted on 20 May 2025, but the next step is negotiation of the Pathogen Access and Benefit-Sharing system as an annex. WHO lists the seventh IGWG meeting on the Agreement for 6–17 July 2026.

relatedSourceLedgerEntries.title: EUDI Wallet remains a late-2026 implementation watch, with new research warning about user oversharing risks
relatedSourceLedgerEntries.summary: A June 2026 study on EUDI Wallet-style credential disclosure warns that users may overshare sensitive credentials, including official ID attributes, and that assistant-style mitigations reduce but do not eliminate disclosure mistakes.

relatedSourceLedgerEntries.title: ECB says digital euro aims for potential first issuance during 2029 if EU legislation is adopted in 2026
relatedSourceLedgerEntries.summary: The ECB states the Eurosystem moved to the next phase of the digital euro project in October 2025 and aims to be ready for potential first issuance during 2029, assuming EU legislation is adopted during 2026. The ECB frames the digital euro as a central-bank digital form of cash complementing banknotes and coins.
